name: La Quinta Resort & Club
insider_take: Desert elegance meets championship golf in this legendary Coachella Valley retreat that's been hosting Hollywood royalty since 1926.
whats_special: This historic resort sits on 45 acres of meticulously landscaped grounds featuring 23 tennis-style courts, five championship golf courses designed by legends like Pete Dye, and the famous Morgan's Restaurant where Frank Sinatra used to dine. The property maintains its original 1920s Spanish Colonial architecture while offering modern luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a casita room for the most authentic experience – these individual adobe-style accommodations with private patios and fireplaces are what made this resort famous among old Hollywood stars.
dont_miss: The PGA West Stadium Course's iconic 17th island green (just next door), sunset cocktails at Adobe Grill's patio overlooking the Santa Rosa Mountains, and the resort's world-class spa treatments featuring desert-inspired therapies using local botanicals.
pros: Historic resort with authentic Spanish Colonial architecture
World-class golf courses including Pete Dye Mountain Course
Stunning Santa Rosa Mountain views and desert landscape
cons: Resort fee applies for amenities and services
Desert location requires transportation for off-property dining
